Re-read 2026-10-31 against the publisher text and the figure image; the 2026-10-30 'correction' dropped the word Il6.

ops.text: The null-hippocampus Tnf-a increase is not significant (Fig 4E); only Il6 is. Any proposal whose seed is the null-hippocampus TNF transcript (S085) rests on a non-significant observation; the P47T cerebellum TNF (n 6, p<0.05) is a separate observation.

need.label: Redox state and NRF2 pathway tone in WWOX-deficient neural cells (ROS, NRF2 target activity, Il6/Il1b output)

goal.basis: Protection of function if ROS or a cytokine output is harmful; unresolved.

observed.statement: Drosophila neuronal Wwox knockdown raises mitochondrial hydrogen peroxide (roGFP2-Orp1; t 3.221, P 0.0047, N 9-11; Supplementary Fig 2U).
observed.limits: Invertebrate, one reporter, one panel; not a WWOX-DEE model.

observed.statement: Wwox-null mouse embryonic fibroblasts: ROS is higher in late passage, not in early passage; redox-homeostasis transcripts (Nfe2l2, Nqo1 among them per the manifest; one sample per genotype) are higher in early-passage nulls; N-acetylcysteine corrects senescence escape.
observed.limits: Non-neural; transcripts of one sample per genotype for the redox set.

locators.anchor: Supplementary Figure 8 is a 16-row Agilent heatmap

observed.statement: Human WWOX-knockout cerebral organoid, week 15 (4 v 2 libraries, one deposit): IL6 0 counts in all six libraries, IL1B 0-11, TNF 0-1; NFE2L2 0.75x, NQO1 0.73x, HMOX1 1.67x, SRXN1 1.33x (cpm ratio, descriptive): no cytokine-expressing compartment and no coherent NRF2 signature.
observed.limits: Unplanned descriptive reading; 4 v 2 libraries; transcripts are not NRF2 activity; no microglia.

inferred: That NRF2 pathway activity, ROS or cytokine protein differ in WWOX-deficient mammalian neural cells: none is measured.
That an early-passage antioxidant response (raised redox transcripts without raised ROS in MEFs) is adaptive and may already be at ceiling in neural cells: an open question.

intervention_direction.rationale: Raise NRF2 only IF ROS is harmful and NRF2 tone insufficient (arm R) or IF a cytokine-expressing compartment exists and its Il6/Il1b output is harmful (arm C); both conditional, none established.
intervention_direction.do_not_assume: That raising NRF2 is beneficial because ROS is raised in a fly or in late-passage fibroblasts; that a macrophage mechanism (Il6, Il1b lowered, Tnf unchanged) operates in microglia; that omaveloxolone or any compound acts in a WWOX-deficient neural cell.

counter_evidence: Human organoid shows no cytokine-expressing cells and no coherent NRF2 signature.
Early-passage redox transcripts are already higher in Wwox-null MEFs (possible ceiling).
Rat lde/lde glia are lower than wild type; null-hippocampus Tnf-a is not significant.
